Dayana Barboza.
Art as a lifestyle.

bio.hook: I started painting jackets simply with the intention of making a special gift, without thinking about techniques or materials—I just wanted to give something made with my own hands. From that spark, Amazing Project was born: a journey that began without feeling completely prepared, without art degrees, without experience.
paragraphs: I started painting jackets simply with the intention of making a special gift, without thinking about techniques or materials—I just wanted to give something made with my own hands. From that spark, Amazing Project was born: a journey that began without feeling completely prepared, without art degrees, without experience.

Five years have passed since then, and it still takes me by surprise when people call me an artist. But time has taught me that art needs neither academies, nor galleries, nor accolades. What art truly needs is patience, discipline, and countless attempts.
Art also demands continuous learning, and great wisdom to navigate both the rush of inspiration and the weight of frustration.
Art is an uninhibited form of expression, and its beauty lives in the eye of the beholder.
Art is so generous that it gives you permission to call yourself an Artist.
bio.quote: I believe in the woman who chooses to build her dream, who dares to take risks and try. And I believe there are beautiful stories that deserve to be painted.

sections.title: Art & Celebration in an Evening
sections.description: We design a private art experience for you and your guests. A bespoke gathering centered around the project that inspires you most. You bring the idea, we guide you through every stroke.

sections.title: Intimate Sessions
sections.description: Designed for private groups of 5 to 12 guests. We provide all the materials (with the exception of garments for textile art, which carry an additional cost, or you may bring your own favorite piece).

sections.title: An Unforgettable Keepsake
sections.description: The outcome will be truly memorable. An extraordinary shared experience for you and your guests, taking home a cherished heirloom piece crafted by your own hands.

events.microcopy: Private groups available for birthdays, celebrations, baby showers, and corporate gatherings. Ask about availability.

steps.title: Share your vision
steps.description: Tell me what inspires you—a loved one, a movie, a place, a meaningful moment. Together, we will craft your perfect design.

steps.title: Refinement & design
steps.description: We fine-tune colors, composition, and every detail until the design is flawless. Then we create the final sketch for your approval. I use premium jackets from brands like Levi's or Gap, or you can send your own if you prefer.

steps.title: The piece comes to life
steps.description: The creative journey begins. We prepare the canvas where your approved sketch will emerge. Your vision comes to life with rich pigments and deliberate brushstrokes. We stay in close contact so you can follow the progress.

steps.title: Final details & delivery
steps.description: Once the artwork is complete, we apply the final protective seal. Ready to ship! You'll receive high-resolution photos of the finished piece along with all tracking and delivery details.

clientStories.title: Voices from the Atelier & Collections
clientStories.subtitle: From hand-painted bespoke jackets to inspiring art education: hear directly from those who experience the art of Dayana Barboza.

featured.quote: Beautiful work, Dayana! Your talent and creativity truly transformed the jacket into a unique, one-of-a-kind masterpiece. The care, meticulous detail, and passion you put into your craft shine through in every brushstroke. It’s such a joy to see how you bring an idea to life with such breathtaking artistry. I couldn't be happier with your incredible work. My absolute highest recommendation!
featured.author: Nora S.
featured.imageAlt: Nora S. wearing her custom hand-painted My Neighbor Totoro denim jacket

secondary.quote: I absolutely love my 'Blossoming Beauty' jean jacket! It is so much more than a jacket—it feels like a piece of art created especially for me. I'm amazed by the attention to every little detail, from the hand embroidery to the gorgeous floral lining. It perfectly expresses who I am. It is truly one of a kind, beautifully handcrafted, and made with so much heart. I couldn't be happier!
secondary.author: Andreina M.
secondary.imageAlt: Andreina M. wearing her custom hand-painted Blossoming Beauty denim jacket

secondary.quote: I really love the classes; each session is dynamic, engaging, and different, so we always have the opportunity to learn something new and develop our creativity. The teacher is very kind, patient, and dedicated, taking the time to guide and help us whenever needed. I love that the classes don't just focus on painting, but also on experimenting, learning, and enjoying the process. There are outdoor activities where we explore art further. The atmosphere is relaxed and I feel completely comfortable trying new things; stepping out of my comfort zone has been the best part. An enriching and beautiful experience. Highly recommended!
secondary.author: Leydi Pastillo

secondary.quote: A truly wonderful experience! My daughter attends this art class and we are so happy with her progress. Dayana is exceptional: very kind, respectful, patient, and caring with children. The love and dedication she pours into every single class is truly noticeable. She is also very responsible and always punctual with schedules. My daughter thoroughly enjoys her classes and has developed even more creativity and enthusiasm for art. Without hesitation, we recommend this class 100%! 💕🎨 A beautiful, welcoming space where kids feel comfortable, happy, and motivated to learn. We are thrilled!
secondary.author: Frexy Da Silva

secondary.quote: I truly enjoy the classes; every session is dynamic, entertaining, and unique, giving us the opportunity to constantly learn something new and expand our creativity. Dayana is remarkably kind, patient, and dedicated, taking the time to teach and support us whenever we need it.
